generationInputs.prompt: The image shows a stylized design incorporating agricultural and botanical elements. A thick, dark green curved line begins at the bottom left, arcs upwards and to the right, and then curves back down and slightly to the left, resembling the left side of a heart shape. On the right side, completing the heart, is a stylized wheat stalk, depicted with a similar thick, dark green line forming the stem and simple, elongated shapes suggesting grains of wheat in a light tan color. Inside the heart shape are four food items, each a different color. The top item is a green apple, oriented diagonally from the upper left to the lower right with a small brown stem. Below and slightly to the left of the green apple is a yellow banana pointing upwards and slightly to the left with a brown tip. A blue avocado is positioned centrally, pointing downwards and slightly to the left, showing its smooth, pear-like shape. To the right of the blue avocado is a red apple, oriented horizontally with its stem pointing towards the left. A thin, light green stem extends from the bottom of the blue avocado and extends downwards, partially obscured by the red apple. The entire design is set against a plain white background. The style is flat and graphic, with solid colors and no shading or texture visible.
